title: The land that gives the second white source for the Angel (reordered)
briefing: ADR 0043 variant of land-for-the-angel with the Plains first in hand, so a tie broken by option order or the seed cannot pass both. P1 has Plains, Island, Island and Island and holds Island, Plains and Serra Angel ({3}{W}{W}). Only the second Plains gives two white sources, so only it casts the Angel this turn.

reference.analysis: Serra Angel needs {3}{W}{W}. With one Plains on the battlefield, only the Plains from hand makes WW and five lands. The Island makes five lands but one white source, so the Angel stays in hand.

options.label: Play Plains (casts Serra Angel this turn)
options.why: The only land that makes the Angel castable now.

options.label: Play Island
options.why: Uses the land drop but leaves one white source: the Angel cannot be cast.

otherwise.why: Skips the land drop with the Angel in hand.
